title: Youth programs that spend far more per participant than others in the same strategy
question: Which programs spent at least three times the middle cost per participant of their funding strategy (and at least $250,000)?
finding: 19 program-years. Highest: Rocking the Boat, Inc. - Rocking the Boat (2024-25): $250,000 for 7, 47.1 times the strategy middle; Rocking the Boat, Inc. - Rocking the Boat (2025-26): $252,500 for 23, 11.3 times the strategy middle; Project Level - Project Level (2024-25): $294,830 for 20, 9.6 times the strategy middle.
how: Expenditures divided by individually counted participants, compared with the median of the programs in the same strategy and year (strategies with three or more programs that report participants).
limits: Participants leave out young people reported only in aggregate, which inflates cost per participant where aggregate reporting is common. Some programs are intensive by their nature (residential care, round-the-clock presence in custody) and serve few young people at high cost.
